gloss: to think up; to hit upon; to come up with

definitions.gloss: to think up; to hit upon; to come up with
definitions.explanation: To arrive at an idea or solution through thought. Emphasizes reaching the idea by thinking rather than its merely occurring to one.

examples.japanese: ⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦{方法|ほうほう}→方法：03621_houhou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{考|かんが}え{付|つ}いた。
examples.english: I thought of a good method.

examples.japanese: ⟦{誰|だれ}も→誰も：18610_daremo⟧⟦そんな→そんな：01645_sonna⟧⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{考|かんが}え{付|つ}かなかった。
examples.english: No one came up with such a plan.

examples.japanese: ⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{解決策|かいけつさく}→解決策：19395_kaiketsusaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦なかなか→なかなか：01547_nakanaka⟧{考|かんが}え{付|つ}くこと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できなかった→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: I couldn't manage to come up with a solution to the problem.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: Transitive godan verb. X⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{考|かんが}え{付|つ}く. Compound of ⟦{考|かんが}える→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧ (to think) + ⟦{付|つ}く→付く：01960_tsuku⟧ (to occur to). Emphasizes reaching an idea through active thought.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{方法|ほうほう}→方法：03621_houhou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{考|かんが}え{付|つ}く: to think up a method
- ⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦{案|あん}→案：01776_an⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{考|かんが}え{付|つ}く: to come up with a good idea

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{思|おも}い{付|つ}く→思い付く：02027_omoitsuku⟧: to hit upon — the idea simply occurs to one, with less emphasis on deliberate thinking
- ⟦{考|かんが}え{出|だ}す→考え出す：21026_kangaedasu⟧: to think out — similar, with a slightly stronger sense of producing the idea
